query:
SELECT a.slug AS "slug!", r.password AS "password!", r.maxmemory_mb AS "maxmemory_mb!",
                  p.port AS "port!"
           FROM redis_instances r
           JOIN apps a ON a.id = r.app_id
           JOIN app_ports p ON p.app_id = r.app_id AND p.name = ?
           ORDER BY a.slug
